authorityReview.evidence: Human review of the pinned Comet implementation, main interface, and Ethereum USDC role. The exact nonpayable buyCollateral(address,uint256,uint256,address) declaration has no outputs. The fixed implementation path transfers the caller-selected baseAmount of the configured base token from msg.sender, computes the configured collateral purchase, checks protocol minAmount/reserve conditions, and transfers the configured collateral token to the caller-selected recipient. Asset, minAmount, baseAmount, and recipient remain caller-selected ABI values without platform-specific bounds; base-token approval may be a separate prerequisite, not automatically paired. Protocol pause, configuration, pricing, balance, and reserve checks may reject a call. Dated role and pinned source do not prove current proxy/runtime identity, liquidity, execution success, or financial safety.
